description: A lattice of impact-diffusing mesh threaded just beneath the skin of the torso. Invisible under clothes, it turns a killing blow into a bad bruise: armor you never take off.

failure_messages.burnout: Threads part somewhere under the skin, one after another, like a seam giving.
failure_messages.dead: The weave is dead mesh now. It's still in you; it just isn't doing anything.
failure_messages.fault: The lattice seizes and locks across your ribs. For a moment you can't get a full breath in.
failure_messages.strain: The weave under your skin tightens across the chest, and breathing gets a size smaller.

name: Subdermal Weave
